title: Use Viva Main Overview (Hazlet) to access system subscreens and high-level AGV controls
summary: Navigate the Viva main overview home screen (Hazlet) to reach the subscreens (Detail/Statistics/HMI Calculations/API/RMS) and locate the right-hand system control actions (start up/shut down/bag out/purge/resume/pause all AGVs) plus the system layout areas (Sorter/Tippers/Hospital/GLDS).
when_to_use: Use when you need to (a) confirm you are on the Viva main overview home screen for system overview/navigation, (b) open the subscreens listed in the main menu (Detail/Statistics/HMI Calculations/API/RMS), and (c) find the right-hand system control actions and the system layout areas (Sorter/Tippers/Hospital/GLDS) for system overview operations.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Open the Viva main overview (Hazlet), navigate via the main menu to the required subscreen, and identify the right-hand system control actions and system layout areas on the overview.
access_or_tools_needed: Viva main overview UI elements: Main Menu, system layout (Sorter/Tippers/Hospital/GLDS), right-hand controls (start up/shut down/bag out/purge/resume/pause all AGVs)

system_preconditions: Viva main overview home screen is reachable and loaded in the Viva HMI client

visual_references.description: Viva (Hazlet) main overview frame showing: main menu subscreens (Detail/Statistics/HMI Calculations/API/RMS), right-hand system controls (start up/shut down/bag out/purge/resume/pause all AGVs), and system layout areas (Sorter/Tippers/Hospital/GLDS) with clickable icons.

steps.title: Open the Viva main overview (Hazlet) system overview/navigation home screen
steps.purpose: Establish the correct Viva context so the main menu, system layout, and right-hand system control actions are available for navigation and overview operations.
steps.instruction: Open the Viva main overview/home screen for system overview and navigation (Hazlet).
steps.expected_result: You can see the Viva main overview frame that functions as the system overview/navigation home screen, including the main menu area, the system layout areas (Sorter/Tippers/Hospital/GLDS), and the right-hand system control actions.
steps.healthy_condition: The screen shows the overview purpose text indicating it is the home screen for system overview/navigation, with the right-hand controls visible.
steps.failure_condition: The screen does not show the Viva main overview layout (missing main menu subscreens and/or missing right-hand system control actions).

actions.label: Open Viva main overview
actions.exact_action: Open the Viva main overview screen (main overview/home screen for system overview and navigation).

stop_or_escalate_if: If the main menu subscreen items (Detail/Statistics/HMI Calculations/API/RMS) are not visible, stop and request support to confirm the correct Viva screen/context is open.

steps.title: Use the main menu to locate subscreen navigation items (Detail/Statistics/HMI Calculations/API/RMS)
steps.purpose: Identify the exact subscreen navigation labels so you can open the correct Viva subscreens from the overview.
steps.instruction: On the main menu area of the Viva main overview, locate the subscreen navigation items labeled: Detail, Statistics, HMI Calculations, API, and RMS.
steps.expected_result: The main menu shows the subscreen items labeled exactly as: Detail, Statistics, HMI Calculations, API, and RMS.
steps.healthy_condition: All five menu labels are visible in the main menu area on the overview screen.
steps.failure_condition: One or more of the expected menu labels are not visible on the main menu area.

actions.label: Locate main menu subscreens
actions.exact_action: Locate the main menu items labeled: Detail, Statistics, HMI Calculations, API, and RMS.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the main menu subscreen items (Detail/Statistics/HMI Calculations/API/RMS) are not visible, stop and request support to confirm the correct Viva screen/context is open.

steps.title: Navigate to the desired subscreen using the main menu
steps.purpose: Open the selected subscreen so you can access the corresponding view (Detail/Statistics/HMI Calculations/API/RMS).
steps.instruction: Use the main menu to navigate to the desired subscreen (Detail, Statistics, HMI Calculations, API, or RMS).
steps.expected_result: Selecting a subscreen from the main menu changes the view away from the overview to the selected subscreen.
steps.healthy_condition: After selecting a subscreen label, the screen content updates to reflect that subscreen (i.e., the subscreen view is shown rather than the overview).
steps.failure_condition: Selecting a subscreen does not update the view.

actions.label: Select subscreen from main menu
actions.exact_action: Select the desired subscreen from the main menu (Detail/Statistics/HMI Calculations/API/RMS).

stop_or_escalate_if: If a subscreen does not update after selection, use the on-screen tip to click 'ACB1- AMR TT' (as shown in the overview tip) and try again; if it still does not update, stop and request support.

steps.title: Locate the right-hand system control actions (startup/shutdown/bag out/purge/resume/pause all AGVs)
steps.purpose: Find the exact high-level system control actions available from the Viva overview for system overview operations.
steps.instruction: On the right-hand side of the Viva overview, locate the system control actions labeled: start up, shut down, bag out, purge, resume, and pause all AGVs.
steps.expected_result: The right-hand control panel shows the labeled actions: start up, shut down, bag out, purge, resume, and pause all AGVs.
steps.healthy_condition: All listed control actions are visible on the right-hand side of the overview.
steps.failure_condition: One or more of the expected right-hand control actions are not visible.

actions.label: Identify right-hand system controls
actions.exact_action: Locate the right-hand system control actions: start up, shut down, bag out, purge, resume, pause all AGVs.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the right-hand control actions (startup/shutdown/bag out/purge/resume/pause all AGVs) are not visible, stop and request support to confirm the correct Viva screen/context is open.

steps.title: Identify system layout areas (Sorter/Tippers/Hospital/GLDS) and note clickable icons
steps.purpose: Confirm the overview’s system layout areas so you can interpret where each subsystem is represented and access more information via icons.
steps.instruction: In the system layout area on the Viva overview, identify the major areas shown: Sorter, Tippers, Hospital, and GLDS. Note that icons can be clicked for more information about Tippers/Hospitals/GLDS.
steps.expected_result: The system layout shows the labeled areas Sorter, Tippers, Hospital, and GLDS, and the UI indicates icons are available for more information about Tippers/Hospitals/GLDS.
steps.healthy_condition: The labeled layout areas are visible and the Tippers/Hospitals/GLDS regions show clickable icons.
steps.failure_condition: The system layout labels (Sorter/Tippers/Hospital/GLDS) are missing or icons for more information are not present.

actions.label: Identify layout regions
actions.exact_action: Identify the system layout areas: Sorter, Tippers, Hospital, and GLDS; click icons for more information about Tippers/Hospitals/GLDS.

steps.title: Verify you are on the correct Viva overview context (Hazlet) before operating controls
steps.purpose: Prevent operating the wrong screen by confirming the Viva overview context is correct (Hazlet system overview/navigation home screen).
steps.instruction: Verify the screen is acting as the system overview/navigation home screen for Hazlet by confirming the presence of the main menu subscreens, the right-hand system control actions, and the system layout areas.
steps.expected_result: The Viva overview context is confirmed: main menu subscreens (Detail/Statistics/HMI Calculations/API/RMS), right-hand controls (start up/shut down/bag out/purge/resume/pause all AGVs), and system layout areas (Sorter/Tippers/Hospital/GLDS) are all present.
steps.healthy_condition: The overview purpose text and the expected labeled UI elements are visible together on the same screen.
steps.failure_condition: The expected overview elements are not all present together (e.g., missing menu items and/or missing right-hand controls).

actions.label: Confirm overview context
actions.exact_action: Verify the Viva overview frame indicates it is the main overview from Hazlet.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the main menu subscreen items (Detail/Statistics/HMI Calculations/API/RMS) or the right-hand control actions (startup/shutdown/bag out/purge/resume/pause all AGVs) are not visible, stop and request support to confirm the correct Viva screen/context is open.

success_criteria: You can identify the Viva main overview as the system overview/navigation home screen (Hazlet).
You can find the main menu subscreens labeled Detail, Statistics, HMI Calculations, API, and RMS.
You can locate the right-hand system control actions labeled start up, shut down, bag out, purge, resume, and pause all AGVs.
You can identify the system layout areas labeled Sorter, Tippers, Hospital, and GLDS.
healthy_conditions: Main menu shows: Detail, Statistics, HMI Calculations, API, RMS.
Right-hand controls show: start up, shut down, bag out, purge, resume, pause all AGVs.
System layout shows: Sorter, Tippers, Hospital, GLDS, with clickable icons for more information about Tippers/Hospitals/GLDS.
failure_conditions: Main menu subscreen items (Detail/Statistics/HMI Calculations/API/RMS) are not visible.
Right-hand system control actions (start up/shut down/bag out/purge/resume/pause all AGVs) are not visible.
Selecting a subscreen does not update the view.
escalation_guidance: If the main menu subscreen items or the right-hand system control actions are not visible, stop and request support to confirm the correct Viva screen/context is open.
